blocks.title: Front matter
blocks.content:
Refer to https://www.who.int/teams/immunization-vaccines-and-biologicals/policies/position-papers for latest position paper updates. 
* For some antigens the WHO position paper does not provide a recommendation on interrupted or delayed schedules at this present time. When the position paper is next revised this will be included. In the meantime, some of the recommendations are  
based on expert opinion. ** See Table 2: Summary of WHO Position Papers - Recommended Routine Immunizations for Children for full details. *** Same interval as primary series unless otherwise specified.
